description: Scientific sampling design for strengthening en-es semantic-veto curve and product-quality evidence without biasing the expanded suite toward current known failures.
global_rules: Pre-register sampling lanes, quotas, split policy, and promotion claims before authoring or generating rows.
Keep representative, stratified, targeted, control, discovery, and locked-eval rows separate in every output.
Do not tune thresholds, formula weights, source evidence, or prompt templates on locked-eval rows.
Do not ask LLMs to create rows that fool or repair the current scorer; prompts may name only the linguistic case contract.
Treat missing metadata and underfilled strata as findings, not as permission to substitute known failure rows.
Use stable random seeds and deterministic row IDs so later agents can reproduce the sample plan.

split_policy.interpretation: Discovery rows can choose hypotheses. Locked-eval rows only check hypotheses after selection.

lanes.purpose: Estimate product-facing allow/abstain rates under ordinary browser-like exposure.
lanes.sampling_frame: Normal app candidate replacements from observed browser or corpus-like contexts, sampled by expected exposure/admission probability.
lanes.selection_method: Probability-proportional-to-exposure random sample, deduped by source trigger, target lemma, and normalized context.
lanes.context_policy: Prefer observed or corpus-sampled sentences. If LLM-generated proxy contexts are used, mark them as proxy and do not call the lane representative browsing.

lanes.purpose: Measure difficulty curves across case type, frequency/rank, and polysemy cells without letting common easy cases dominate.
lanes.sampling_frame: Eligible source triggers and candidate replacements grouped by pre-outcome metadata.
lanes.selection_method: Balanced random sample within each predefined stratum; underfilled cells remain underfilled and are reported.

lanes.purpose: Test the current strongest curve mechanisms while labeling the rows as discovery or locked checks, not representative product data.
lanes.sampling_frame: P0 cells from the curve-guided expansion report, currently phrase/no-winner underfilled/rank cells, positive-active low-score cells, and shadow near-tie cells.
lanes.selection_method: Use the curve-guided queue priority, but consume only P0 first; P1/P2 remain staged until P0 rows rerun.

lanes.purpose: Detect lexical leakage, scorer-shaped prompts, and label leakage before expansion results are trusted.
lanes.sampling_frame: Control rows spanning target-lemma-only traps, shuffled active/shadow labels, low-polysemy no-shadow controls, and no-winner mention-only contexts.
lanes.selection_method: Fixed quota plus seeded random trigger selection inside each control family.

stage_plan.entry_condition: Current curve-guided report and product-quality policy are present.
stage_plan.exit_condition: Sampling design report is generated, reviewed, and committed; no rows authored yet.
P0 manual rows and representative sampling-frame candidate list are materialized; no threshold or scorer changes.

stage_plan.entry_condition: Manual rows confirm each P0 cell contract and prompts pass leakage review.
stage_plan.exit_condition: LLM discovery rows are admitted and scored separately from manual rows.
Locked-eval rows are scored once, and curve reports are rerun without changing the locked lane.
